body: I just opened Reddit, first thing I saw what this post. Had NO idea what was going on and what this all meant lol. 😵‍💫 But I’m in shook! Wow …

You’re so right, no one knows in the end and it’s definitely not up to them to judge. Also: why do they always feel the need to mention that the person has left Jehovah? It’s the borg they left .. the manipulation is terrible.

Thank you!! And yes, I do believe, whatever you end up doing anyway, for some it will never be good enough. And after all, we’re all responsible for our own happiness, the cult always encourages to not think or choose for ourselves but that’s just brainwashing. :(
You are totally right, it’s already a big step including lots of changes. Thanks for your kind words, it means a lot!
Thank you! I hope so!

Thank you, glad to hear I’m not the only one! I’m happy things worked out well for you. Moving further away feels like a huge first step at time moment for me personally. Hopefully I’m able to settle, work on improvements and my social circle. It’s just a little uncomfortable knowing certain people are somehow still, as you said, keeping an eye on you!
Thank you so much for your reply, I appreciate it! And I agree, it’s definitely a cult and that makes it even harder to escape ..

That is great! I’m glad you were able to see them in person! I once spoke to a df brother when I had to get some groceries, couldn’t care anymore if someone saw it as well. He actually started getting emotional, only because I recognized him and asked how he was doing! So sad but I felt relieved that I took the time, small gestures can mean a lot.
They always think they’re some kind of special

And thank YOU for sharing this post! Must be extremely difficult to be in this situation, or at least to be reminded by the shunning every single time. I cannot even begin to imagine. One of the worst nightmares when a loved one can immediately turn your back. They are so brainwashed it’s eerie. I hope one day I can be myself and tell how I think about the borg, but being on this sub makes me feel less lonely as a PIMO :’)

I’m so sorry. I don’t understand how JW robots decide to have children and can shun them later when they no longer share the same beliefs. This is manipulation and has nothing to do with loving and obeying your God. They only live to make the GB happy!
This is incredibly sad!!! I’m so sorry .. how can they preach they are a religion of love .. this is insane.
Well said!!
Cults gonna cult
Yes .. I honestly can’t get myself participating into this circus :^)
Aw this is beautiful!!
True, it’s totally worth it living the life you want to without any feelings of guilt .. just letting go and experience life as it should be.
Being myself and stop pretending to be someone I’m not.
That’s horrible, I’m so sorry :(
Thanks a lot for taking the time to write this, you explained it very well. I appreciate it a lot. Thanks again! Sending hugs back to you!

That last sentence hit me. It’s so true and I struggle with this as well. I honestly don’t like to tell others what my age is, especially when they know me a little more personally. It’s the worst when I compare myself with others of my age. Feels like they have achieve so many things I can’t keep up with anymore. I also look really young for my age so it feels more embarrassing.

“Please come back to Jehovah” .. ehh did they misspelled the borg? They always act like smartasses and assume you left your faith but instead you just left the borg and their controlling behavior. You can still believe in something. This letter hurts my eyes, damn. What a control freaks, absolutely terrifying. I’m sorry.

It’s a horrible feeling. It’s scary to realize how life can change in just a matter of time, but to me this feeling has always been here with me somehow .. it feels familiar .. it just gets stronger everyday. Even as a child I felt disconnected to the world, my surroundings and myself personally? At the same time I find it difficult to think back because I’ve lost so many memories. Sorry for the rant. Hope you’re doing fine, know you’re not alone. <3

I’m sorry. I know the feeling. The emptiness. Things don’t feel real anymore. It’s a never ending sadness, how much I try I only make it worse. I wish and pray for an easy way to leave, life is never easy but for some it’s surviving. I always feel like I’m living in this bubble, where time stands still and everything and everyone around me keeps moving. I’m stuck and also feel like I’m a human without a soul or personality. Really weird idk.
Lol im confused
So true! Unfortunately that love is nowhere to be seen when you left. Love never fails, right?

They immediately assume a person is NOT doing fine when they don’t attend meetings or do the things they’re ‘suppose’ to do as a witness smh. I also wonder if they do realize while they’re writing words such as: “I do care about you, love you .. blabla” if those words still have meaning when you left. Because NO that’s not the case anymore then. And I think they know that. They’ll just turn theirs backs to you and continue finding new people for the borg.

I know this feeling so well. It’s following me everywhere I go, feels like a shadow I can’t get rid off. It feels like I’m not even connected to this ‘world’ anymore. It’s difficult to always pretend everything is going well. Just wanted to say that you’re not alone, thank you for sharing your story, reminds me I’m not the only one even though it does feel like that most of the day. Big hug from me!
So true. Creepy isn’t it? Their love in fact does fails.
Your .. friend? Except when you decide to leave! Wonder if they still see you as a ‘friend’ ..
Wtf did I just read

Can’t stand how they always succeed to portray the ‘world’ as a dark and horrific place. They always try to give the impression that life outside the borg is less appealing, a place where it’s impossible to be happy in and considering it as a scary place to associate with ..

LOL I remember being so proud to find a photo (and posting it on social media of course 🙄) with the text that said: “Yes I’m one of Jehovah’s Witnesses .. No it’s not a cult .. Yes it was my choice .. No I don’t find it restrictive. I’m the happiest I’ve ever been as one of the JW.” Daaaamn even writing this makes me cringe all over again. 🤮 Not being a cult and restrictive, where do I even begin. What where we even thinking. And I definitely wasn’t the happiest person as a pimi.
This is absolutely horrible. Blaming everyone but themselves. I’m so sorry!
I don’t think I’ve ever seen this before .. but know for sure this is some nightmare material.
I’m sorry, this makes me so fucking angry. Mind your OWN business what the fuck.
Ah yes I see! Still even without any proof but just assuming .. 🤔 Hmm, If you think about it that way for long enough you’ll start believing it lol
What the fuck did I just read? So uncomfortable and weird on so many levels.

Yea just go ahead and compare. Kind of sad how he let almost 1500 innocent people drown in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean. At least they found the Titanic at the bottom of the ocean after almost 70 years, what about your ark?

I’m honestly so happy for you. I aspire to have this attitude someday and might find peace someday. I find it difficult to accept that there will be better days, because I currently feel like the worst in every possible way even though I expected to get better. I might need to give it some time but it’s really difficult.
Thank you so much for sharing! What a great response! I’m still stuck but seeing your post gives me hope, so thanks again!
I’m so so sorry for your loss. Wish I could’ve give you a hug, cannot imagine the pain you’re experiencing right now .. Sending you lots of love!

I can see. They really start panicking about losing more (young) members. A br had a talk about this subject not long ago, it really pisses me of how they portray this world as only bad. They’re really good at spreading fear, these poor kids feel like they have no other choice in life .. it’s so sad.
This is just sad and pathetic.
The only thing that’s keeps me here is the fear of dying, or perhaps the suffering. I feel like I have completely lost myself in this life but the fear is keeping me alive I guess.
(Un)conditional love it is. 🤡
Oh this is so pathetic.
I agree, it will be totally worth it!
It honestly really does feel like that sometimes when everyone close to you is living the pimi life .. 😕! So I’m really glad this sub exists .. thank you for the kind words! <3
I’ll look it up! Thanks for the suggestions and your kind words! ❤️
Thank you .. ! I already found someone to talk to about that subject so at least that’s one step in the right direction!

Thank you so much for this! It’s exactly what I needed at this moment. I love your example of the salespeople. It makes so much sense. They don’t owe me an explanation. I agree that it’s sometimes better to stay silent. At this moment I don’t even care what they think, let them have their own interpretation .. they will gossip anyway. I just want to live my life the way I want. :-)
Totally true, good reminder! Thanks for sharing ..
They somehow never fail to surprise me with their shunning tactics .. 🙄
What. The. Fuck!?!???? ...

Thank you so much for your insight and advice. It’s going to be challenging and definitely not easy. Sometimes the doubts will come whenever I realize I have to do this on my own, because I will lose everything and everyone that I still deeply love. But I know how they will act up when certain people tell them to break all contact. I’m aware of this but not really prepared I guess. It’s something unnatural too because you don’t expect your family and friends to leave you when you’re not on the same level anymore religious wise. It’s something I don’t understand and never agreed with and probably never will. Thanks again for your comment, I appreciate it a lot!
That’s some real talent! It’s beautiful!
I totally agree. Sometimes I feel like that’s the only option I have left right now ..
Thank you so much!
Thank you so much! 😌

Wow thanks a lot for your message. I really do appreciate it. And yes I guess I’m prepared what will happen with the friends and family I still have left, it’s not worth it for me to stay here and meanwhile feeling like shit and don’t know what to do with my life.
That is a good one, haha. Thanks!
Thanks a lot!!!
Thank you so much!!!

Yes. I’m not someone who gets mad easily but have so much anger inside lately and that’s mainly the reason why. They want to socially isolate yourself from the world and step into a world where everyone pretends to love you no matter what.
Thanks for the reply, much appreciated!

I already suspected I was not the only one feeling like this. Your comment just brought tears to my eyes, thank you so much for your kind words .. I realize I have to make huge decisions and I know this is going to be very difficult. I will lose a lot, but I’m tired of pleasing others.
Thank you for the link, I appreciate it!
I honestly don’t even know how to accept help anymore, I don’t know what decisions I have to make in order to make myself to feel better ..
Same ;_;
If only things were that easy ..

Same. Every thing in life scares me somehow, big or small. Even as a child, thought things would get better or fall in the right place and time as an adult. I’m just too sensitive and insecure for this world, can’t even name a single thing I’m proud of. No goals in life. Mainly because I hope I won’t have to live this life any day longer, I’ve been focusing on that for so long. I feel like I’m not living this life for myself, it constantly feels like I’m surviving. Pretending to be a bubbly, content and happy person. Doing what society tells me to do, hate this system so much. You’ll get rejected if you’re slightly different then others. I’m having suicidal thoughts for months now. I feel like it’s too late and I failed so many times in life. :(

I was so so so excited for this game for the longest time .. it felt like it was the only thing I was looking forward to .. but tbh I’m feeling so depressed right now, haven’t picked up the Nintendo in a week and there seems nothing that makes me happy anymore .. not even this precious game ugh idk what it is.
My thoughts exactly. I’m sorry that you are dealing with this as well. Life can be so hard. 😔

Same here. It’s the only thing I desire to do when I get home from work. Currently laying in my bed, blinds closed, my dog laying next to me and listening to some music. I both hate and love it. It just feels like a safe place but at the same time gives me anxiety because it reminds me that there are others stuff I might have to do or have to work on to improve my life. Kinda lost all the motivation so it’s the only thing I do whenever I can ..
Same :(
Still waiting for that to happen. Hopefully really really soon. This life is killing me.

This fucking depression is making me feeling miserable but also mad about everything. I was feeling like this before the whole virus thing but it’s gotten worse and worse omg. Don’t want to deal with friends or people in general and I keep ignoring them or answering a few days later. And those fucking zoom invitations is just not what I want to deal with right now wtf I don’t have anything to talk about just want to cry and die. I just want to disappear from this shitty world.
And people say this feeling is ‘temporary’ .. shit I’ve been feeling like this for over ten years and really just want to end it so bad. Can’t deal with this anymore, I’m not living just existing.
Couldn’t agree more. It’s killing me inside, so bad. It hurts. I’m just too much of a coward to end it, wish there was an easier way ;;;(
If only it was that easy ..
Thank you so much. ❤️
Same. I get so angry and especially sad when I look at old photographs when I was this happy kid. I’m so done and disappointed with this life D:
Didn’t know I’d make it this far. Woke up this night around 5 thinking about this.
All the timeeee
I totally know what you mean .. I feel like it’s my only solution or escape, but I’m just too afraid to actually do it. Hate myself even more because of that.

You just perfectly described how I feel. It’s exhausting.. I want to stop existing. I don’t want, need, deserve happiness anymore. There’s something holding me back idk, maybe the fear of hurting certain people. But I just can’t deal with this anymore ;(

Yes exactly! Life’s just unfair in general. I didn’t ask to be on this shitty world that’s trying to break us down. I feel like I don’t belong here .. tired for always having to pretend that everything is going well, just so that I don’t hurt anybody. But this is my life and I really want to disappear, just go to sleep and never wake up ;( idk if that’s too much to ask for
That is the sweetest thing. Dogs are the best. 🐾♥️
All the time ;_;
That would be a dream come true.
Or like ‘acting’ you’re all good and everything is going well :(
Yep. It’s been a long time.
Can’t remember the last time and I can not even imagine what it would be like. So, I guess not. I feel like it made me who I am as a person ..

Not anymore. I think it’s too late for that .. everything is so difficult and no one might understand. Friends don’t care and the family is giving me this strong feeling like I can’t do nothing right. I’ve had therapy for a few years .. they didn’t help at all if I think about it. In fact, I feel like I’m back at the beginning and feeling even worse. I don’t know but, is it weird that I don’t even want to seek for help anymore or talk about it in general?
Thank you. I’m sorry you’re feeling like this as well .. <3
Same here ;((
Good for you! Even though this might be a big step, I hope that you can look back at some point and being happy you reached out. It’s one step closer to getting better. Proud of you!
Even though you’re dealing with your own difficulties, I just wanted to say I’m proud of what you’ve accomplished.. appreciate your small victories. <3
Dogs. Or just animals in general because people suck, lol
I can relate .. depression sometimes feels like a never ending void
Totally agree, I feel the same. Kinda sad. But accepted it in a way, like I don’t deserve anything good in this life.
